source.text_layer: hybrid (annual report p.1-149 text; financial statements p.150-273 scanned)

notes: Annual report: the narrative (p.1-149) has a text layer; the financial statements start at p.149 (title) and are scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers; the statements' own folio + 150 = file page). Thousand Baht. Single set of columns (no subsidiaries). The SCI (p.157) prints the tax expense as a positive figure; it is turned negative. Every note page carries the running header 'สำหรับปีสิ้นสุดวันที่ 31 ธันวาคม 2568', also on the comparative pages: the year is taken from the table's own column header and confirmed by the opening balance (p.221 is 2567, opening CSM 7,141,995). Note 18 (p.238 2568, p.240 2567; columns ordinary / group / annuity / personal accident / total) - the total column is used. CSM roll-forward 14.1.1.2 p.220 (2568) and p.221 (2567); future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). New business 14.1.1.3 p.222 (both years): the totals are used; the split between the non-onerous and onerous columns is unusual (2568: 401 and a CSM of 40 in the other column; 2567: the loss of 68,490 shown under the non-onerous column), the totals reconcile. No PAA business. RA release uses note 18 (227,129 / 183,957), equal to the AOC RA. Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses.
